title: Motion-Picture Film - 16- and 8-mm Reversal Color Camera Films - Determination of Speed
scope: 1.1 Specifications This standard specifies a method for the determination of speed of 16-mm, 8-mm type R, and 8-mm type S reversal color camera films intended for direct projection in motion-picture photography. 1.2 Basic standard ISO 2240 constitutes the basis for this standard.
